title: Reduce R439 route calls with window-restored packet residency
head: 8b82afa62da2647a0022775bdc2e19f7f4b3ac6e
body:
PR2481 restores both borrowed dirty packet banks after every R439 event. This construction permits packets to remain resident across events and restores all originals and both banks at the whole-window boundary. For the unchanged 313-event word, it reduces route calls and exchanges from **1,232 to 1,084**, and outer packet XOR work from **4,009 to 3,565 P-record passes**. The extra permission to keep originals exchanged is explicit.

An exact dynamic program supplies an attaining schedule with **542 residence intervals**, versus 616 per-event intervals. The minimum applies only to two full resident slots, a fixed common layout, fixed chronology, and events requiring their ordinary source/target to be resident. The proof removes prefetch and unnecessary early eviction without increasing cost. It is not a global reversible-routing minimum.

Concurrent [PR2519](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2519), pinned at `fe9ca26c8df754ccadbb3df89c721dad3b497b48`, uses a different one-bank direct-original update: 1,232 routes, 626 exchanges and 2,191 XOR passes, with per-event restoration. This result has fewer route calls but more exchanges, XORs and borrowed capacity, plus a weaker intermediate ownership guarantee. No overall dominance, additive saving or improved supplier budget is claimed.

The proof covers arbitrary correlated dirty payloads under reversible route children that preserve parked originals and inactive banks. The complete GL2(Z/9) replay checks 431,811 formal input records, all 431,568 family outputs including 422,577 unowned records, resident values and parked dirt at every event, and every evicted packet's restored logical value. Forward and reverse fragments pass. Seven reason-bound faults reject invalid dirty copying, final-flush omission, missing inverse routing, wrong resident ownership, lost carries, a transient snapshot write and wrong tap chronology.

Validation: native CPython 3.12.7 registered primary and two scheduling tests pass; optimized primary passes too. Both scheduling policies agree with an unrestricted prefetch/early-eviction recurrence on all 1,554 short request words over three families. A separate AI reviewer passed the optimized native3.14.5primary and scheduling tests, reviewed the ownership proof, and independently ran an unrestricted DP over all 111 actual families, confirming 542 loads in both directions. No material issue was found within the stated model. No human/formal-kernel review or hosted CI pass is claimed.

Only `research/r439-resident-packets` is added. The retained PR2448 source-window/carry-route implementation and PR2481 finite harness are explicitly credited; exact source bytes, SHA256 and Git blobs are included. PR2481 is pinned at `d3ec95362a071e2726c5ff4ce587de80c7d4f984`, PR2448 at `76311b90337a04dd811877d101c86ff8ecd65904`. Selected and frozen evidence remain unchanged. Canonical main was refreshed at selection, scope pivot and before submission; base remains `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority4.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-resident-packets
python3.12 -I -O -B research/r439-resident-packets/verify.py
```

Outer fresh payload, CLEAR and disposal counts are zero. Borrowed capacity, full-family exchange scans, packet head returns and finite route work are counted; physical headers/control, uniform GL64 routing, route-private scratch, complete caller hosting and all-size admission remain open. This is a conditional local adapter and scoped minimum, not a full supplier or new kappa.

Overlap coverage is bounded: complete cached 679 open PRs at12:25UTC and1,197Discussion records at12:29UTC, supplemented with recent100 then30open-PR REST reads and direct2481/2519head/body/comment checks. GraphQL quota prevents fresh complete Discussion coverage; no match is not proof of novelty. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2481#issuecomment-6193562425).

Credit ywz65/PR2481, Ross Richardson/PR2448/2407/2437 and Jose Manuel/PR2195, plus the retained supplier/exporter lineage. Standard caching and reversible exchange identities are not claimed as new; this is their exact-window ownership contract, attained restricted minimum and counted realization. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
